products.name: Cheek Thrills Multi-Finish Face Trio
products.shortDescription: CHK THRILLS MLT-FNSH FACE TRIO APRES-SKI
products.description:
Features

  • Multi-tasking, multi-finish face palette
  • Includes a satin cream, luminous balm & velvet powder
  • Tonal color combinations
  • Builds, blends & layers flawlessly

Key Ingredients

  • Phytomucin known to have antibacterial, antioxidant & brightening properties
  • Mango Butter & Jojoba Oil known to moisturize & soften skin

Formulated Without

  • Fragrance
  • Talc

attributes.name: how_to_use
attributes.label: How To Use
attributes.value:
Press Satin Cream onto your skin to add a flush of color to your bare cheeks, apply over Velvet powder to bring skin back to life, or pair under the Velvet Powder to intensify your color payoff.  

Tap the Luminous Balm onto cheeks before applying blush or bronzer for a glow-from-within effect; use as a highlighting topper, or wear solo for subtle color.  

Sweep the Velvet Powder on cheeks for a soft wash of color or tap on top of a Satin Cream to step up your flush and mattify your finish.
